fidelity_checks.single_candidate_bh_rank_note: Each run passes exactly one candidate to run_validation(), so G05's Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment always uses rank=1 within that call, rather than this candidate's true rank among the official run's full reported candidate list. family_size is still the real, documented 33085 (not shrunk). rank=1 against a fixed family_size is the *most conservative* (largest) BH-adjusted p-value achievable for a single candidate -- strictly harder to pass than the candidate's real historical rank would have produced, so this cannot be the reason a trap fails to be rejected here; it could only make G05 spuriously fail a trap that would otherwise pass, which none of the recorded raw p-values are close enough to for this to matter (all raw p far below alpha at any plausible rank).
